result.summary: Several layout and overflow issues: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, and the last popular-restaurant card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is clipped on the right, cutting off the name 'Trattoria Piccol' so it is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Add proper padding/peek on the horizontal scroller and ensure card titles wrap or truncate with ellipsis instead of being cut by the screen edge.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in 'Popular right now' is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name, rating, and other details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height (plus safe area) so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The category filter chips overflow the right edge ('Healthy' is partially cut off with no clear indication of more options).
issues.suggestion: Leave a visible peek of the next chip or add a fade/scroll hint so users know the row is scrollable.

issues.description: The promo banner subtitle uses a very light gray on mint green, which is hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet contrast guidelines against the green background.
